title: The Boltzmann constant is fixed at 1.380 649 × 10⁻²³ J/K
summary: BIPM marks k exact and ties the revised kelvin to it.
body: BIPM prints the Boltzmann constant k as 1.380 649 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹, with no uncertainty. The NIST 2022 listing prints the same number as exact, in J K⁻¹. BIPM's base-units page says the revised kelvin is based on this fixed value. The kelvin is the base unit of temperature. This card does not restate a laboratory realisation of the kelvin.

sources.title: The International System of Units (SI): Defining constants

sources.note: Page opened 2026-11-18. BIPM dates the fixed values to the revision that took effect on 20 May 2019 and cites CGPM Resolution 1 (2018).
